summary: Streamtime is a Sydney-headquartered project management SaaS for creative businesses, with presence in the UK, owned by Software Combined since 2022 and certified B Corp since December 2024. Camila Saavedra is Head of Accounting (since Nov 2021) and Julian Retamal is Finance Manager overseeing Australia and the UK; he began on bank reconciliation across multiple accounts.

hooks.text: Camila's B Corp post about turning good intentions into clear processes: repeatable, auditable close processes.
Julian's remit across Australia and the UK, started in bank reconciliation: reconciliation is the daily core of a very small finance team.
Software Combined ownership implies group reporting on top of the local close.

risks.text: Owned by Software Combined (UK group); group policy may dictate finance tools, and no funding or hiring trigger found.
Very small finance team (Camila and Julian); budget may be limited.

gaps: No finance job ads found; no podcast or blog by Camila on finance topics; billing/Stripe setup not confirmed from public sources.
